name: Bill Rounds
office: City of Santa Fe Springs, Member of the City Council

items.text: Bill Rounds was first elected to the Santa Fe Springs City Council in 2007 and served as mayor in 2012, 2017, and 2020. He served 11 years on the planning commission and retired from the LA County Sanitation District.

sentences.text: Bill Rounds was first elected to the Santa Fe Springs City Council in 2007 and served as mayor in 2012, 2017, and 2020.
He served 11 years on the planning commission and retired from the LA County Sanitation District.

items.text: In 2020, he voted to change landscaping contractors to save roughly $71,000 annually. In 2008, he served on a subcommittee to renegotiate the Whittier police contract. In 2016, he said moving the fireworks show to Sunday would let police focus on illegal fireworks. In 2022, he called a 140-unit affordable housing proposal a 'definite improvement.' As mayor in 2025, he spoke at the Aquatic Center's Phase Two groundbreaking, calling the project a commitment to wellness and inclusion.
